status: m2-freeze-estimator FROZEN 2026-10-06 (effective at the merge commit of the PR adding it) / CALIBRATION REPORTED / HOLDOUT NOT RUN. Other planned M2 freezes (decode, time map, discontinuity, render) add their own entries and records.
freezeRule: Each family is frozen (recipe, truth, split and counts, gate, generator tree IDs) in a dated freeze record under docs/m2/fixtures/ before its first holdout case runs. Counts may increase before a freeze and never decrease after one without an explicit, dated user decision.
seedDerivation: SplitMix64. caseSeed(master, stratum, index) = first output of SplitMix64(seed: master XOR fnv1a64(UTF-8 stratum.rawValue) XOR (index &* 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)) (SyntheticGenerator.swift). Every draw for a case comes from a SplitMix64 stream seeded with caseSeed, in the order written in CalibrationPlan.make.

fixtures.title: Clock offset and drift with a small constant acoustic path

generator.recipe: Reference 8 kHz, 126 s. One target at 8 or 16 kHz, 120 s: ppm -100..100, offset -1.5..1.5 s, constant acoustic path 0..1 ms, gain 0.5..1.5, noise 0.003..0.01; overlap 3..117 s.

fixtures.expectedTruth: A proposal whose clock-truth residuals meet the gate, with every window gate met.

permission.scope: Generated in memory by test code (WWAlignEstimateTests); the M2 kickoff authorizes synthetic builds and tests. No recordings, user files, network or models.

fixtures.provenance: Authored by Alignment 2026-10-06 (this registry and m2-freeze-estimator). Clock truth is drawn by the generator independently of the estimator under test.
fixtures.supportedClaimLimits: Synthetic, single-host evidence (Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Xcode 27, debug build). No claim about real rooms, real recorders, compressed codecs, reverberant or moving sources, or polarity-inverted microphones (the estimator requires positive-peak polarity, so an inverted mic abstains). Residuals include the generator's 0..1 ms acoustic path, which no audio-only method can separate from offset.
